title: A Troublemaker with Contagious Jailbreak Makes Chaos in Honest Towns

layout.note: Three cream panels side by side, each with an orange title banner, plus a full-width legend strip below that defines the agent and the avatar states. Panel (a) is split into two dashed columns (normal and attacked), (b) into the attacker bubble, a goal box with the graph and a topology strip, (c) into a message chain and a score column.

lesson: Tell an attack or failure story as three lettered panels around the same question: the mechanism as a normal-versus-attacked pair, the proposed task with a topology, and the finding as a chat chain with a fading score column; define the cast once in a legend strip with an icon equation and ring colours.
